layout: Three-panel comic strip with alternating characters having conversations across a table. Each panel has a text bubble with dialogue above or near the characters.
character_position: Characters are seated at a table, each occupying roughly 20-30% of the panel space. One character is on the left with a hat, the other is a green figure on the right.

text_style.color: Black text on white speech bubbles with black outlines.
text_style.position: Text is positioned in speech bubbles above or to the side of the characters.

content_structure: Conversational format with observational humor. Each panel presents one part of a dialogue that builds on the previous one to create a humorous effect.
description: A meme featuring two cartoon characters at a table discussing the lack of benefits from quitting caffeine, expressed with conversational humor.
